name: Baptism of Rus under Vladimir the Great
summary: Grand Prince Vladimir of Kiev formally adopts Byzantine Christianity and mass-baptises the Rus population in the Dnieper at Kiev. The decision aligns Rus with Constantinople rather than the Latin West, permanently shaping the religious geography of Eastern Europe.

_quarry.structural_significance: Brings the Eastern Slavic world into the Byzantine cultural orbit; establishes Slavonic-language liturgy and a Cyrillic literate clergy that becomes the backbone of medieval Russian statecraft.
